# Kit Registry: chuang-platform-kit

**Generated by `python scripts/build-kit-registry.py` from the docstrings: do not edit by hand; edit the
docstring and regenerate.** `tests/test-kit-registry.py` fails when this file is stale or a public name has no
docstring.

**Kit first:** before writing anything a second project could use (a retry, a REST client, a webhook's
check, a once-only claim, a sender), read this file. If the kit has it, import it; if it is close, change the
kit (a kit commit, a tag, the pin bump in each host). A host's own registry lists only its own code.

## `cache`: In-process answers kept for a few seconds, a per-caller throttle, and a once-a-window gate: the rea…

| Name | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `get(key, clock=)` | The value kept under `key`, or None when there is none or it is stale. |
| `put(key, value, ttl, clock=)` | Keep `value` under `key` for `ttl` seconds; the value back, so `cache.get(k) or cache.put(k, load(), 30)` reads as one line. |
| `cached(key, ttl, load, clock=)` | The kept value under `key`, or `load()` kept for `ttl` seconds. A falsy answer (an empty list) is kept too, which `get() or put()` would re-load. |
| `clear(prefix=)` | Drop every kept answer (or those whose key starts with `prefix`): a write happened, so the next read is fresh. |
| `throttle(key, limit, window, clock=)` | None when this call is within `limit` calls per `window` seconds for `key`, else the whole seconds to wait (at least 1) before the next. Count only the calls the cache could not answer, and give each caller (a session, a device, a job) its own key: on 10/6/26… |
| `once(key, window, clock=)` | True the first time `key` is asked in each `window` seconds, False until then: a warning said once a minute however often it applies. |
| `reset()` | Forget everything (the tests' fresh start). |

## `config`: A versioned configuration document, read at runtime from one source, cached, with a change signal.

| Name | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `class Document` | One read of the configuration: its `version` (any string that changes when the content does: an updated-at stamp, a hash, a counter), its `data` (a mapping) and when it was read. |
| `lookup(data, key, default=)` | The value at a dotted `key` path ('booking.target_time') in nested mappings, else `default`; a flat key with a dot in it is tried first, so either spelling works. |
| `class Config` | A cached, versioned configuration document with a change signal (module docstring). |
| `Config.version()` | The current document's version, '' before one has been read. |
| `Config.mark_dirty()` | A change signal: the next read fetches again, whatever the ttl says. |
| `Config.on_change(callback)` | Call `callback(old_version, new_version)` whenever a new document is taken. |
| `Config.refresh(force=)` | Read the source if it is time (ttl passed, dirty, or `force`): True when a new document was taken, False when unchanged, skipped or unreachable (then `stale` says so). |
| `Config.get(key, default=)` | The value for `key` (a dotted path): the document's, else the fallback's (before any document has been read), else the code's default, else `default`; KeyError when none has it. A fallback value that disagrees with the document is a WARNING, once per key. |
| `Config.typed(key, kind, default=)` | `get(key)` coerced to `kind` (bool reads 'true'/'1'/'yes' from a string); a value that cannot be coerced answers `default` (or raises ValueError without one). |
| `Config.snapshot()` | Every key as the reads would answer it: the defaults under the document (or the fallback). |
| `etag(version)` | The ETag for a document version (quoted, as the header wants it). |
| `unchanged(if_none_match, version)` | True when a request's If-None-Match names the current version (the 304 case). |
| `provider(config, name=)` | An OpenFeature provider over a Config: every flag read is `config.get(key)`, typed, with the document's version as the variant. Needs the `config` extra (openfeature-sdk). |

|---|---|

| `WhatsAppMessage.from_dict(data)` | Create from dictionary. |
| `WhatsAppMessage.from_json(json_str)` | Deserialize from JSON. |
| `WhatsAppMessage.validate()` | Validate the message has required fields for its type. |
| `create_dm(phone_id, message, source=, dry_run=, include_signature=, include_joke=, correlation_id=)` | Create a direct message to an individual. |
| `create_group_message(group_id, message, source=, dry_run=, include_signature=, include_joke=, correlation_id=)` | Create a message to a group chat. |
| `create_poll(group_id, question, options, multiple_answers=, source=, dry_run=)` | Create a poll in a group chat (signature/joke not applicable). |
| `create_image(recipient_id, image_url, caption=, source=, dry_run=, include_signature=, correlation_id=)` | Create an image message with optional caption. |

## `whatsapp_publisher`: WhatsApp Message Publisher for Pub/Sub Event-Driven Architecture

| Name | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `configure(project_id=, topic=)` | Tell the publisher where to publish: the GCP project and the Pub/Sub topic. A host calls this once from its config module, so the kit never carries a project's name. |
| `publish_whatsapp_message(message)` | Publish a WhatsApp message to Pub/Sub for async delivery. |
| `send_dm(phone_id, message, source=, dry_run=, include_signature=, include_joke=, correlation_id=)` | Send a direct message to an individual. |
| `send_group_message(group_id, message, source=, dry_run=, include_signature=, include_joke=, correlation_id=)` | Send a message to a group chat. |
| `send_poll(group_id, question, options, multiple_answers=, source=, dry_run=)` | Create a poll in a group chat. |
| `send_image(recipient_id, image_url, caption=, source=, dry_run=, include_signature=, correlation_id=)` | Send an image with optional caption. |
| `publish_raw(message)` | Publish a pre-constructed WhatsAppMessage. |
